look_here_first: Low sprawling sensitive-briar with twice-compound leaves that fold when touched and pink-lavender globose flower heads.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; ITIS accepts Mimosa latidens; Texas flora sources describe its sprawling sensitive-briar habit.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Mimosa species have bipinnate leaves and globose heads of many tiny flowers; several species have touch-sensitive leaflets.
best_field_traits: up to about 3 pairs of pinnae
morphology_keys.comparison_training: More herbaceous and mat-forming than woody M. borealis and M. texana.
